meta.title: Sudut Desa — Village specialities, straight from the makers
meta.description: A catalogue of village small-business products. Find local specialities and souvenirs, then send your order straight to the maker on WhatsApp.

footer.about: A catalogue of products from partner villages. Orders go straight to the maker on WhatsApp — no middleman, no commission.

home.heroTitle: Village specialities, straight from the makers.
home.heroSubtitle: Shop cassava chips, coffee, bamboo crafts and farm produce from villages across West Java. Order on WhatsApp, no middleman.
home.villagesAside: Every product has an origin and a story

1.title: Pick a product
1.body: Browse by village or search by name.

2.title: Chat the seller
2.body: Choose a quantity, then open WhatsApp with your order already written.

3.title: Agree directly
3.body: Payment and delivery are arranged directly with the maker.

verified.title: Village verified
verified.body: Every business is checked and approved by its village admin before it appears.

direct.title: Straight to the maker
direct.body: No middleman and no commission — your money reaches the maker.

mentored.title: Mentored by HIMA SI
mentored.body: SATU University students help each business prepare its products.

about.title: About Sudut Desa
about.lead: Sudut Desa is a programme by HIMA Information Systems, SATU University: a catalogue of products from partner villages, with digital mentoring and training for the people who make them.
about.how: Each village has its own page managed by its village admin. Businesses are verified once by the village, then buyers can order their products directly on WhatsApp — no middleman, no commission.
about.pilot: Pilot village: Desa Baros, Arjasari district, Bandung regency.
